text: Film v1 (139 shots, 4:10, 48 min on NVENC) came back "almost oneshotted"; the operator's notes were all set-level: a pile-up where a line stopped (1:12, 1:30), a hand clipping through a lever grip (2:10), white-slab inserts, an unreadable outro, and an intro that cut where the music does not build.
